quest.title: Complex Cartography
quest.description: A visibly troubled adventurer from Liyue stands by the riverside in Sumeru. Is some kind of problem giving them grief...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

talks.objective: Talk to the adventurer from Liyue

dialogues.speaker: Peixiu
dialogues.text: Geez, I'll have to trouble Lan again... But it's not like I have a choice. There's simply too much work, and I'm only one person. How am I supposed to finish?

dialogues.speaker: Peixiu
dialogues.text: I have no choice but to delay the mapping submission again. If this goes on, my living expenses here in Sumeru will exceed the deposit for the commission...

dialogues.speaker: Peixiu
dialogues.text: B-But there's nothing more terrifying than Lan's rage... *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's an adventurer from Liyue doing over here...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! You! From the Adventurers' Guild!

dialogues.speaker: Peixiu
dialogues.text: Huh? What's wrong? Am I not allowed to rest by the river here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: An adventurer from Liyue in Sumeru...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's really rare! And you even look super anxious, so we came over to ask if we could help!

dialogues.speaker: Peixiu
dialogues.text: I see. I'm Peixiu, and you are?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}! So, Peixiu, what are you doing here in Sumeru...? Ah! Paimon knows! Did you get lost!?

dialogues.speaker: Peixiu
dialogues.text: Ahahahaha! So the cute little one is Paimon! Hahaha, lost...

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: ...Under most circumstances, no, it wouldn't be funny. But asking a cartographer if he's lost is quite amusing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C-Cartographer?

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: Yes, we are responsible for surveying the landscape and updating older maps... It's one of the Adventurers' Guild's duties.

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: I am one such cartographer, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But?

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: I'm just an apprentice. I've completed some rough sketches, but there are tons of mistakes. I need to get to a shaded valley or tunnel to carry out a detailed survey.

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: Ugh, this is killing me. The terrain here in Sumeru is so complex, and there are so many roads and caves too. Sometimes, I wonder if the entire mountain is hollow...

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: Progress is just way too slow... *sigh* I don't know the terrain as well as the locals do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Then why don't you get a local adventurer to do it?

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: Er, it's actually a joint project between the Sumeru and Liyue branches of the Adventurers' Guild, and a completed map will be provided to those who trade or venture between the two.

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: It was entrusted to the Liyue branch because the Adventurer who was supposed to be in charge had cartographic experience, and her reputation is that of absolute reliability.

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: Supposedly, she already did something similar in Qiaoying Village. All it took was a single glance for her to know all the terrain inside and out, and her maps were very precise too.

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: But she left for some mining area. Uh, did she go to the Chasm or Blackcliff Forge...

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: Anyway, once we laid eyes on her map, we all felt ashamed of our own skills. The adventurers who used her map praised it to the skies!

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: I can't compete with that... I may have drawn a map, but there are too many omissions, and surveying everything again will take too long...

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: *sigh* I'm a stranger in a strange land. I may have the support of Sumeru's Adventurers' Guild, but I'm just not efficient enough. If this goes on much longer, the deposit I received won't even be able to cover my travel expenses.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, that sounds awful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We don't really know much about cartography though... Maybe Paimon can help mark where you can find delicious food on your map instead?

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: Haha! That's a great idea! A map showing all the best local cuisine would definitely be popular!

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: But... well, my remaining work doesn't really require drawing the map. What's left is a final survey to verify the map's accuracy...

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: There are a few dangerous locations surrounded by difficult terrain that I haven't been able to get to.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, if that's all...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That doesn't sound very difficult...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, maybe we can help!

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: But most of these locations are really dangerous! There may even be monsters roaming around.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's exactly why you should leave it to us!

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: R-Really...? With your help, it feels like I'll be done in no time! I may even make the deadline...

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: Most importantly, supplying travelers with an updated map will help prevent them from getting led somewhere deserted or dangerous by the old map!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds great! Hehe, but we'll only help you on one condition! And that is that you have to mail us a copy of your food map once you're done making it!

response.speaker: Peixiu
response.text: Hahaha! But of course! However, this map has to be verified before any of that can happen! It's all up to you now!
